longDescription: Test your camera, microphone, and speaker before joining any online meeting (Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Discord, etc.). This extension provides a quick and reliable way to ensure all your devices are working correctly before important calls.
Simple, lightweight, and privacy-focused. No recording, no tracking, everything runs locally on your device. Perfect for remote workers, students, and anyone who relies on video conferencing.

extensions.name: Desky Clock
extensions.summary: Smart Pomodoro timer built around your real workday — meeting-aware, media-aware, and fully configurable

details.tagline: A smart Pomodoro timer built to work around your real workday — not against it.

featureDetails.title: Focus Timer
featureDetails.description: Set your focus and break durations. Desky Clock runs silently in the background and brings up a full-screen break when it's time to step away.

featureDetails.title: Full-Screen Break Screen
featureDetails.description: A distraction-free black screen with a live countdown, breathing cues, and rotating wellness tips covering eye strain, posture, hydration, and movement.

featureDetails.title: Auto-Restart Loop
featureDetails.description: After every break the next focus session starts automatically. Just start once and let it run all day.

featureDetails.title: Meeting-Aware
featureDetails.description: On a Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams call? Desky Clock detects it and silently queues your break until the meeting ends.

featureDetails.title: Media-Aware
featureDetails.description: Watching YouTube or Netflix when a break is due? A small prompt asks if you want to take the break now or skip it — your choice.

featureDetails.title: Streaks & Daily Stats
featureDetails.description: Track your focus streak, sessions completed, and total focus minutes. Set a daily session goal and watch your progress bar fill up.

configurableOptions: End-of-day summary at a time you choose
Your own custom break activity prompts
privacyFeatures: All data stays in your browser's local storage
howToUse: Install the extension from the Chrome Web Store
Click the Desky Clock icon and set your focus duration
Hit Start — Desky Clock runs silently in the background
A full-screen break screen appears when it's time to rest
The next focus session kicks off automatically after each break
